title: Stasis Spell Shop
description: A surreal nighttime scene of a magical shop entrance with an arched doorway. A silhouetted wizard in a long coat stands in the doorway holding a small glowing butterfly-like object, while a wooden sign reads 'STASIS SPELLS LOCKED FUSION EST. 0233'. Swirling blue and brown paint-like forms drip from above with keys, scrolls, and papers floating in the air. A vendor cart with potions and rolled scrolls sits on the wet cobblestone street.
